meaning_ko: 셀피, 셀카(자기 자신을 직접 찍은 사진)
example_en: She posted a selfie from the top of the hill.
The novel borrows filmic techniques such as sudden cuts between scenes.
He still keeps a handwritten note from his grandmother.
My brother has practiced taekwondo since he was six.
Children gradually internalize the rules their families live by.
The deposit is non-refundable once the booking is confirmed.
She scraped the uneaten rice into the bin.

meaning_ko: 업사이클링(버려진 물건을 더 가치 있는 것으로 되살리기)
example_en: Upcycling turns worn-out jeans into sturdy shopping bags.

meaning_ko: 컬처테인먼트(문화를 오락 상품으로 만든 것 — culture + entertainment 합성어)
example_en: Critics warn that culturtainment reduces heritage to a theme-park ride.

meaning_ko: 시대 중심주의(자기 시대의 기준으로 다른 시대를 재단하는 태도)
example_en: Temporocentrism makes us judge past societies by today's standards.

meaning_ko: 환상의, 환영과 같은(실재가 아닌 상상 속의)
example_en: The painting has a fantasmatic quality, as if glimpsed in a dream.

meaning_ko: 침입 가능성(생태계가 외래종에 뚫릴 수 있는 정도)
example_en: Dense native vegetation lowers a habitat's invasibility.

meaning_ko: 생애 주기, 수명 주기(생물이나 제품이 생겨나 사라지기까지의 과정)
example_en: Engineers study the full lifecycle of a battery before approving it.
The cathedral owes its monumentality to sheer scale rather than ornament.
Clean air has enormous non-market value that no price tag captures.
He reads a new webtoon episode every Friday morning.
The hall was rebuilt to correct its acoustical flaws.
She switched from history to archeology in her second year.

meaning_ko: 협력적 경쟁(경쟁하면서 동시에 협력하는 관계 — cooperation + competition 합성어)
example_en: Rival carmakers practice coopetition when they share charging networks.
The band played until the dancefloor was packed.

meaning_ko: 확정성, 명확함(값이나 의미가 하나로 정해져 있는 성질)
example_en: Legal drafting aims at determinacy so that terms cannot be twisted.

meaning_ko: 기질적인, 성향에 관한(상황이 아니라 개인 성향에서 비롯된)
example_en: We too readily give dispositional explanations for other people's mistakes.

meaning_ko: 세분성, 입도(정보나 작업이 얼마나 잘게 쪼개져 있는지의 정도)
example_en: The report offers little granularity, lumping all regions together.
A single honeybee visits thousands of flowers in a day.
His teaching style is improvisatory, shaped by whatever students ask.

meaning_ko: 운동 감각적으로(몸의 움직임을 느끼는 감각을 통해)
example_en: Dancers learn kinaesthetically, by feeling the movement rather than watching it.
Good science writing explains findings in terms laypeople can follow.
The policy bans personal calls and other non-work activity on the floor.
Many birds migrate to milder regions during the nonbreeding season.
Eggs slide right out of a nonstick pan.

meaning_ko: 실제로 일어나고 있는, 현재 발생 중인
example_en: Belief can persist without any occurrent thought about it.

meaning_ko: 재현 가능한(같은 방법으로 다시 해도 같은 결과가 나오는)
example_en: A finding is worth little until it proves replicable in other labs.
The pitch succeeded on salesmanship alone, not on evidence.

meaning_ko: (친구 집 등에서) 자고 오는 모임, 파자마 파티
example_en: The twins invited four friends to a sleepover.

meaning_ko: 사회의미론적인(언어의 의미를 사회적 맥락과 함께 보는)
example_en: Politeness forms are best described in sociosemantic terms.

Warmer winters raised survivorship among the smaller fledglings.
Totemism links each clan to a particular animal ancestor.
The film hints at a transcendence of ordinary human limits.

meaning_ko: 연주할 수 없는, 경기를 할 수 없는
example_en: Heavy rain left the pitch unplayable.
He was dismissed as a weirdo long before anyone read his work.
Huddling together is a common antipredatory tactic among small birds.
